exchanges: finally in hamburg!! the flat smells like fresh paint but its mine
Congratulations on the new place. Fresh paint means a clean start.

ok so long story but my flatmate chidi was supposed to meet me with the keys and he was stuck in some pub because Arsenal were playing on tv and he would not leave until the final whistle so i sat on my suitcase for an hour
That is dedication to a team. At least the keys arrived in the end.
lol yes. he made up for it with pizza
Pizza fixes most things.
first day at Tidewater is next week, its one of the container terminals
A big port job. What will you be doing?
im a planner for the yard, deciding where boxes go basically
Like a giant puzzle with cranes.
exactly. my German is terrible tho, doing an app every night
Daily practice adds up fast.
my girlfriend Valentina is still in milan finishing her degree
Long distance for a while then. What is she studying?
architecture, she has one more semester
Then she can join you, hopefully.
thats the plan. bought a bicycle today off a guy online
This is a great city for cycling.
it has a basket and everything
Practical, perfect for groceries.
my uncle dariusz called to check on me, his gout is acting up again so he was grumpy
Sorry to hear it, that can be very painful.
and my great uncle wojciech is in hospital this week, its his diabetes again. nothing serious they said
I hope he is home soon.
thanks. ok what else. oh my old boss hamid is moving to Dubai for a new job
Big move. Did you like working for him?
yeah he was good, he wrote me a nice reference
Good references are worth a lot.
met leonie from my team at the welcome drinks, shes hilarious
Great to have a friend at work already.
she goes to a boxing gym every Tuesday and wants me to come
Could be a good way to meet people.
ehh i prefer rowing, i used to row at uni and there's a club on the alster
That sounds like a lovely place to be on the water.
correction hamid just messaged, its Doha not dubai. i always mix up the gulf ones
Easy to mix up. It should be an interesting change for him.
my birthday is in November so i have to plan something with new people lol
A good excuse to invite your new team.
maybe at that cafe Elbkind near the harbour, its my new favourite
A cosy cafe sounds like a nice spot for it.
chidi says he'll bake a cake which is scary
Brave of him. It might be great.
he once set a toaster on fire
Maybe keep an extinguisher nearby.
wait what was wrong with my great uncle again
leonie is watching Babylon and keeps sending me memes about it
Sounds like she is hooked.
ok bed. early start
Good night, sleep well.
